---
name: dev12-wakeup-loop
description: DEV-12 admin-created task-completed wakeups re-fire on every team run (including own) and agents cannot disable them
metadata:
  type: project
---

On DEV-12 (issue 01a11548-a7fe-7437-9bcd-f1140f9e2130), admin created an event wakeup for each of Dev A–D (mine: 01a11548-a948-7a13-89df-fb576eb11ee8). They fire on task.completed, failed or cancelled from any run on the issue, my own included, with max_fires=20. As of 2026-10-07, `multica issue wakeup disable` on mine returns a permission error, so it can't be turned off. Cancelling a queued wake run is pointless because the next completion re-queues one.

**Why:** Dev A's plan said "disable your wakeup once In Review", but that doesn't work with agent credentials. I reported this in a top-level comment on 2026-10-07.

**How to apply:** on later wake runs, read state first. Dev C owns the sign-off and the move to In Review; I own revisions to `final.patch` when review requests them via a mention. If nothing changed, or the issue is already In Review, post a one-line state reply and stop. Don't try to work around the permission and don't ask peers to disable my wakeup. See [[ansible-clone-verification]].
